subject: english
objectives: 形成 Whose book is this? 等問句。
以 It's Mina's / It's hers 等回答。
區分 whose 與 who's 的功能與展開。

sections.title: whose 詢問所有關係
sections.content: Whose jacket is this? 中 whose 直接修飾 jacket；Whose is this jacket? 中 whose 獨立作補語。

sections.title: be 與被問物一致
sections.content: Whose is this key?；Whose are these keys? 單複數由被問物決定。

sections.title: 回答提供擁有者
sections.content: It's Ben's；It's his；They're the players'。不要只回答 Yes，因為 Whose 不是 yes/no 問句。

sections.title: whose 不等於 who's
sections.content: who's = who is 或 who has；whose 是所有疑問詞。Who's at the door? 問人物身分，Whose bag is here? 問擁有者。

misconceptions.belief: Whose 問句可用 Yes 回答。
misconceptions.whyWrong: Whose 要求人物或擁有者資訊。
misconceptions.correction: 提供姓名或所有格形式。

misconceptions.belief: who's 與 whose 只是拼字差異。
misconceptions.whyWrong: who's 是縮寫，whose 是疑問所有格。
misconceptions.correction: 嘗試展開 who is/has 檢查。

misconceptions.belief: Whose are this keys 正確。
misconceptions.whyWrong: this 與 keys 數不合。
misconceptions.correction: 改為 Whose are these keys?。

misconceptions.belief: 回答 Mina's 後必須再說 hers。

checks.prompt: Whose are these books? 可答什麼？
